archetype.author: Rob Shaw
archetype.work: Chiron in the Signs and Houses
archetype.title: Chiron in the Signs and Houses
archetype.principle:
In any zodiac sign, the higher, refined qualities of education, gentility, and civility for Chiron may find freer expression while reflecting each sign’s modality and element as appropriate to its unique nature. Similar to the Sun, Venus and Jupiter, Chiron may bring about the best of each sign naturally when very well aspected, or after the native transforms their deep chironic pain into a higher octave of expression. However, the centaurs were considered to be dual-natured, and especially if Chiron is negatively placed or aspected, the more sinister themes of the mythical lower centaurs may be seen at first, i.e. – wounding self and others, pain, abandonment, rejection, dissipation, cruelty, surliness, combativeness, impatience, chaos, drunkenness, hedonism, and more. Harsh configurations may manifest victimization of self or others, mental health issues, addiction, jealousy, revenge, and violence that may occur in any sign or house. Chiron afflictions may indicate how, when and where the pain is enacted on the native by others or where the native may afflict pain on their victims, often in very subtle ways. Some people manifest the negative traits of Chiron throughout their life, never able to accept or understand their pain and transform it into their potential greater gifts.

At its best, and after transformation, Chiron may symbolize our greatest gifts, strengths and abilities, and where we may really stand out as a maverick, exhibiting the highest form of human qualities. The hallmarks of a positively influenced Chiron are generally the opposite of the lower centaur traits showing the highest of spiritually-inspired humanity, i.e. – overcoming liabilities, ignoring or working through pain, a welcoming compassion, empathy, kindness and care for others, patience, stability, and an effort for adherence to values and ethics. They may become a natural educator, a maverick who leads by example, and enjoys what makes them unique, and without criticism or judgment of others. These are people we enjoy being around and learning from, and they find ways to not let their woundedness control their lives, and they try not to hurt themselves and other people. (Note that the author prefers the term chironic over chirotic used by other astrologers as an adverb or adjective form of Chiron as it sounds nicer, and refers to the natural irony of Chiron the Wounded Healer.)

At the end of most descriptions in italics is offered a piece of a horoscope noting Chiron placements and aspects. These are limited for privacy reasons (except perhaps in the case of identified celebrities) and merely to represent the chironic influence, not the entire horoscope which would give an even fuller picture. It’s acknowledged that these are somewhat “cherry-picked” to illustrate my interpretations, yet they are real people, and further study of their natal charts would give a more accurate representation.

archetype.author: Rob Shaw
archetype.work: Chiron in the Signs and Houses
archetype.title: Chiron in Cardinal Signs & Angular Houses
archetype.principle:
Chiron in cardinal signs may attract greater conflict or woundedness in personal relationships, but also a greater potential for eventual healing of the self through relationships and conflict resolution. Many cardinal signs are assertive and may put themselves first, but they often take time to help others. Chiron may increase their interest in putting themselves out there, whether they are proud to display their leadership skills, or be naturally more humble, and perhaps share their joy of finding a positive transformation. Their need to be self-concerned may be conscious or unconscious yet in either case they may choose to be someone that can be relied upon, recognizing the often-unspoken quid pro quo facts of life. It’s normal to seek relationships that are balanced in helping each other for all the cardinal signs, not just mutually-rewarding Libra.

In angular houses, there is potential for negative configurations, such as, squares, T-squares, oppositions and Grand Crosses between houses 1, 4, 7 & 10 and their personal contacts may be a great source of pain, or this is where they afflict pain on their more intimate relationships. Whether wounded or wounding, this causes them to retreat into their work to avoid potentially painful intimacy and contributes to loneliness. If there are other considerations in the horoscope, Chiron in a cardinal sign or angular house may point to someone who is a leader or first responder. Major relationships are represented in the angular houses and by personal planets and Chiron affecting these may attract a variety of relationship difficulties, often through aggression by others, reacting in pain with aggression or over-expression, or through not expressing their real needs in fear of rejection.

In positive aspects or after transformation, the native could more easily access their interests in leading others in a way that is truly noble. They may be the hero or truly reliable person in your circle of family, friends, peers, partners, or in the workplace. If they can courageously face their often self-imposed insecurities or limitations, then Chiron may have a softening effect to the self- and goal-oriented signs. They may transform and develop great caring for others, especially in the house where it is located or through planetary aspects.

When negatively aspected (and sometimes even with positive aspects) Chiron in the personal angular houses may attract deep woundedness in their major relationships which may manifest as ongoing unresolved pain in relationships in general. In response, they may behave in hurtful ways in a misguided attempt to seek balance or just be vindictive due to envy, justifying abhorrent behaviour because they are hurting. Without positive counter-aspects these placements may be selfish, run amok and steamroll over others to get what they want. Or they may attract this behaviour from others, whether just in their closest relationships, or if they have a public forum, their behaviour may greatly detract from a positive outcome.

archetype.author: Rob Shaw
archetype.work: Chiron in the Signs and Houses
archetype.title: Chiron in Fixed Signs & Cadent Houses
archetype.principle:
Chiron in the stubborn fixed signs can really cause them to dig in their heels. This may be good or bad or both depending on where the centaur is located and in which signs, but strength, stability, and durability are likely their best attributes. Their maverick side may be seen in their effort to eventually break free of restrictions, whether these are their own or put upon by others, although it may take a long time. They may be very good at providing or building structure in their lives or provide great leadership to others. Although they may experience financial loss or struggles these experiences may teach them how to build better values, status, health and wealth.

In nearly any aspect great endurance and survival skills are likely because they were taught these in their early life or developed them through early hardships. There may be great benefits here for Chiron in the houses that can indicate wealth or social interactions. Sometimes it’s who you know not what you know! They can be real achievers whether this be in their work, finances or relationships, both personal and social when Chiron is well-aspected or after transformation.

With afflictions to Chiron in these signs and houses, repercussions can be shocking, extreme pain may be endured, or great social or financial struggles of some duration may arise which will need to be overcome. They may suffer in silence, but if they do resolve their woundedness then their pain will bring healing, leading them to being stalwart and reliable. If not, Chiron here may be harshly prejudiced or anti-social at worst, and maudlin or grumpy at best. They usually need to learn to let go of the past and move forward.

archetype.author: Rob Shaw
archetype.work: Chiron in the Signs and Houses
archetype.title: Chiron in Mutable Signs & Succedent Houses
archetype.principle:
Chiron here is positioned in areas to which it can more easily relate. In mutable signs, they may be shy at first but their innate need or desire for education, social interaction and connection to groups can really flourish. In areas of communication and education, teaching, health and healing, conducting business, or travel, Chiron here can network to find employment and leadership roles without a need to feed the ego. Training others can really bring about their kinder and more humble personality and they may also appear naturally sweet, witty and entertaining as well as having a seductive charm.

When positively aspected the best values of Chiron in each individual sign may develop through their many talents, and their desire to be of service which can really benefit a lot of people or the masses. Like other planets in mutable signs, Chiron here can be the unsung heroes and unnoticed people providing services that have a great effect on the rest of us as we are being taken care of by them. They may be perpetual students and teachers but enjoy keeping busy with detailed or administrative work.

If afflicted, all manner of personal pain, sacrifice, victimhood, manipulation, possibly cruelty and martyrdom are possible. As a victim or a perpetrator or both! Like the harsher planets in mutable signs, they may get caught up in a never-ending conveyor belt of turmoil, real or imagined. If they are able to transfigure their various systems or purveyors of pain, then they can perform miracles to the benefit of themselves and others. If stuck on victim-perpetrator mode, they may become experts at manipulation and game-playing, or be a perpetual target. Eventual recognition and acceptance that their pains may not be much different from others can help them loosen up and manifest their go-getter and higher qualities.

aries.author: Rob Shaw
aries.work: Chiron in the Signs and Houses
aries.principle: Chiron in Aries may be bold, energetic, courageous and show the potential for leading others which may be in a good or bad way depending on the horoscope. They would likely have a greater interest in their own pursuits, an interest in self-care, or in leadership roles. They are likely to enjoy their maverick personality, and maybe show off a bit. Chiron positioned here would often have a greater belief in how special they are; in positive aspect they may be strong, exhibit bold, courageous actions, and have a tremendous amount of strength and endurance. In negative aspect, there may be more selfishness and egocentricity, perhaps caused by a difficult childhood or other relationship pain. Chiron in Aries people who are abandoned, rejected, unloved, or unseen may harbour an intense short temper, prone to easily getting angry, and perhaps justify their unresolved pain or insecurity for their attacks on others. Vulnerable narcissism is possible, or other mental health problems, as is potential for a head injury. Some may have an aggressively self-centered personality. It’s interesting to note the current worldwide culture of narcissism, celebrity and “justified” inhumanity that has been occurring while Chiron is in Aries until 2026. (female client – Chiron in Aries conjunct Venus in Taurus both in 10th, opposite Uranus in Scorpio in 4th, Uranus in Grand Trine to Mercury in Pisces in 9th and Moon-Saturn conjunction to Cancer in the 12th – suffered physical, mental and emotional abuse by father in childhood, conscious choice to be childless, able to transform pain into tremendous inner strength and knowledge by obtaining degrees and working at a very high leadership role in a major university and whose work affects a large number of people in education.)

cancer.author: Rob Shaw
cancer.work: Chiron in the Signs and Houses
cancer.principle: Cancerians tend to be very caring of others and Chiron brings out this natural behaviour, just as you’d expect from the sign of the Crab. Unfortunately, their moodiness may also be enhanced. They have the best memory of the zodiac and they may never forget when you wounded them. This could lead to their harbouring resentments and other painful life episodes that may cause them to be morose and have them crawl into their shell. It’s difficult to prod a Cancer out of a bad mood and Chiron may augment this tendency causing them even more loneliness and isolation. Their nature may become coldly abrupt or very “business-like” with others when more empathy may be called for. Negative aspects with other personal planets may indicate this more often than positive aspects. With kinder aspects between Chiron here and personal planets they would likely show great warmth and compassion to others, while also enjoying the admiration and support from those they love. In work houses, Chiron in Cancer may exhibit a greater acumen for education and business, particularly financial, investments, and real estate ventures. In health houses or with other appropriate indications, these people may be very good healers whether that be in allopathic medicine or alternative health therapies, especially as a therapist or counselor. (male client – Chiron in Cancer in 2nd in Grand Cross squaring Saturn in Aries in 12th, Mercury in Libra in 6th, opposite Mars in Capricorn in 9th – separate Grand Trine of Jupiter in 9th, Uranus in 12th and Venus-Neptune conjunction across 4th/5th outside of Grand Cross – outstanding VP of IT implementation for major bank, and much-loved family patriarch who raised very successful children, cared for wife with mild mental health issues.)

libra.author: Rob Shaw
libra.work: Chiron in the Signs and Houses
libra.principle: Chiron in Libra can be as charming as any other personal planet in Libra. In fact, their innate charisma may take them very far in life even if not positively aspected. Like other Libra planetary aspects, sometimes the more “negative” ones serve them better than trines and sextiles which may lead to laziness, self-indulgence or selfishness. Chiron here may have a greater need for them to be noticed or perceived as special. This can really go downhill from there with even stronger negative manifestations. Positively aspected or after transformation may see Chiron help in creating an abundance of positive relationships while also enabling a helpful, generous nature volunteering their time for others, especially when leading teams. They can be the people we enjoy being around most as they allow their kind, caring, charming nature be the horse pulling their cart. Like other Libra placements, this one probably works best with an almost equal amount of positive and negative planetary contacts. Woundedness would probably be derived from nearly any relationship and similar to when in the 7th house, most often through marriage and partnerships. Like other signs, the most negative of traits for Libra are more often found in their polar opposite, in this case Aries. Therefore their worst traits may include being abusive, short-tempered, volatile, domineering, ego-driven or selfish, and far from charming. Unresolved Chironic pain may contribute to an odious character and personality. Like other signs that are generally kind and good, when Chiron in Libra goes bad it’s pretty stinky. (Donald Trump – conjunction of Chiron-Jupiter in Libra in 3rd trine Sun, Uranus, North Node in Gemini in 11th and square Venus-Saturn conjunct in Cancer in the 12th.)

capricorn.author: Rob Shaw
capricorn.work: Chiron in the Signs and Houses
capricorn.principle:
Chiron in the sign Capricorn may highlight their more positive traits of being good providers, supportive in relationships, and help them be those warm, reliable people, who as spiritual or business leaders bring success to themselves or others. They are the people we rely upon for leadership. Wherever Chiron in Capricorn is located it may give them a penchant for economics, hard work and a business acumen. This placement may at times be a bit harsh for Chiron which already attracts woundedness due to their guarded nature. Capricorn tends to bury their pain and Chiron here expands that and could lead to them just “giving up” on healthy relationships, or more effort to find a positive resolution. This could then bring about an innate cynicism, detachment or a cold abandonment of any relationships that are not purely transactional. Their taciturn ways work against their happiness, adding to a deeper woundedness, and may lead to their famous tyrannical behaviour at times. If they can dig deep into their fishes tail, a symbol for their innate ability for great emotions, and earthy care and concern for others, they may accept or transform their pain and then manifest the more wonderful Capricorn traits. They certainly show immense strength and survival skills which can serve them well throughout their lifetime. (John Travolta, actor – Chiron in Capricorn in 6th but just 3 degrees before 7th, meaning it can be read forward, conjunct North Node, opposite Uranus in Cancer in 12th creating T-square to Neptune in Libra in 4th, several sudden losses of family members and public highs and lows in his life and career, while also showing great personal strength and resilience.)

Negative aspects to Chiron in the Cardinal signs or angular houses may bring about a host of personal life and relationship problems which may be deeply painful. However, if they can find a way to work with or transform their woundedness then the sky is the limit when it comes to their abilities to heal, lead and educate others as there may have great courage, endurance, and real survivor capabilities while dealing with the fluctuating cycles of life.

taurus.author: Rob Shaw
taurus.work: Chiron in the Signs and Houses
taurus.principle: If Chiron in Taurus is hanging on to the past, they really need to find a way to break free from self-imposed restrictions. Like Saturn or Uranus in Taurus, Chiron here can be severe creating deep woundedness and insecurity. If positively aspected, a good upbringing and close ties to financial security can bring out their best. They’re likely to be stubborn and somewhat old-fashioned but this not necessarily negative in a fast-changing modern society. Attachment to higher ideals, education, and healthier attitudes may ward off or balance a Chiron placement prone to sudden unexpected events. Chiron in Taurus will likely be interested in causes relating to improving society through better health, education and financial security. They may be skilled in earth-related things like horticulture, herbology, gardening, working with wood, clay or stone, and enjoy being outdoors to escape stress. They are also likely to have a greater interest in aesthetics, including beauty, fashion, the arts and celebrity. (Catherine, Princess of Wales – Chiron in Taurus in 5th, exact trine to Sun in Capricorn in 1st – known for excellent parenting skills and devotion to family, her various art interests, and admired for her resilience. Her husband Prince William also has Chiron in Taurus.)

leo.author: Rob Shaw
leo.work: Chiron in the Signs and Houses
leo.principle: Chiron in Leo may draw attention, or increase the need to seek attention or to be special and perhaps lead to some melodrama in their lives. They may attract celebrity due to being a child prodigy or their involvement in the arts. They would not enjoy being ignored or neglected as Chiron’s natural inclinations could lead to a wounded ego. If they were marginalized, criticized, or attacked this could help build great inner and outer strength in Leo, a strong fixed fire sign. Their competitive spirit would be highlighted and contribute to their success. Leo, known for its need to control or obtain power may have a tendency to dominate whether positively or negatively aspected. Although there could still be insecurities with Chiron in Leo, they would probably mask these with overt power plays. Decision making may be stronger than in other signs, as well as an ability for leadership. When happy, Leo can be a pussycat, so with very positive aspects, or after a transformation, Chiron here could be charming, kind, generous, and very loyal. That is if their ego does not get bent out of shape and becomes the centaur leading the cart. In very negative aspects, they may be childish, throwing temper tantrums and expect everyone to bow down to their will. When more positively placed, they could show great abilities in the arts, coaching, guidance or education, and be terrific at inspiring others through their warmth, charisma, and attractive personality. (Nick Jonas, actor, singer – Chiron in Leo in the 1st in a Grand Cross with Moon in Taurus in the 10th, Saturn in Aquarius in the 7th and Pluto in Scorpio in the 4th. Chiron sextile Venus in Libra in the 3rd and other trines in his horoscope appear to provide a more positive outlet for the Grand Cross, especially in the arts and media. particularly as a child star with family as The Jonas Brothers.)

scorpio.author: Rob Shaw
scorpio.work: Chiron in the Signs and Houses
scorpio.principle: Dominance, power and control issues may be strengthened when Chiron is in Scorpio. Similar to when posited in the 8th house, there may be serious victimization or deep woundedness that may be rooted in sexual or other forms of abuse of power. Psychological issues could be highlighted, as well as a great need or desire to move beyond the pain to bring about transformation. If the pain is accepted or absorbed, or with mostly positive aspects to Chiron in Scorpio then the individual could provide wonderful healing for themselves or others. There is likely to be an attraction to healing or social services but also education and the arts. If Chiron connects with other planets that are spiritually oriented based in faith or religion this placement could really enhance these skills, providing strong transformation opportunities to others as a therapist, minister, or medium. There is potential to work with money or other forms of wealth, banking, insurance or investments. Many softer Scorpio placements may enhance their inclination to quietly or secretly care for others and manifest their warm, generous nature and they’ll take their responsibilities seriously. (male client – Chiron in Scorpio in 8th, focal point of T-square with Moon in Aquarius in 11th, Mars-Pluto conjunction in Leo across 5th-6th houses – bullied and sexually abused in childhood, abandoned by lovers due to inability to show feelings and intimacy, but successful career in social services in government welfare system and group homes for abused children.)

aquarius.author: Rob Shaw
aquarius.work: Chiron in the Signs and Houses
aquarius.principle:
The humanitarian nature of Aquarius, a sign usually concerned with higher ideals that benefit all can really aid Chiron’s abilities to transform, heal and educate. If afflicted there may be some pain due to societal or other situations beyond their control, yet this and other positive aspects may assist their inventiveness in social causes that can increase their desire to care and help a lot of people. They may be highly idealistic in love and other relationships, having high expectations of themselves and others. This could lead to unrealistic expectations for others to “toe the line” in adherence to their own standards and habits. This can lead to relationship problems that wound them, corresponding in a detachment from intimacy or relationships that attract lonely periods, perhaps blaming others for rejection. Their attachment to their ideals, unusual activities and work may alienate some people or create a wrong impression, leaving them to the more usual fixed sign tendency to control or dominate, causing more misunderstandings, rejection, and a lack of self-understanding. Still, they may work hard to help others get ahead and overcome the issues that hold them back, especially with more positive planetary contacts, or after a soulful transformation. Chiron may do very well in Aquarius, leading some astrologers to think it is one of the best signs to manifest its greatest gifts. (male client – Chiron in Aquarius in the 7th, opposite Uranus in Leo in the 1st, creating a T-square to Moon in Scorpio in the 4th. Chiron trines Venus in Libra in the 3rd, which conjuncts Sun-Mercury in Libra in 4th,opposing midheaven. – suffered violent physical, emotional, parental abuse in childhood and in marriages, including multiple sexual assaults, abandonment and rejection by family and spouses, a child prodigy in several mantic arts, eventually teaching many of these to others, worked as an artist in graphic arts, publishing and education, primarily in natural or herbal health industries.)

The fixed signs and cadent houses may greatly strengthen Chiron. However, they may be prone to unexpected upheavals or problems that may manifest in sudden, shocking ways. This may really tear them down, yet also provide endurance and a lesser chance of being taken down again as they refocus and build a strong armour of self-protection. Chiron in these signs and houses may develop indomitable strength and abilities they can use for the betterment of themselves and others, and not solely used for dominance and power plays. Their skills may work towards improving others more than themselves.

gemini.author: Rob Shaw
gemini.work: Chiron in the Signs and Houses
gemini.principle: Chiron here would appear to be very helpful to Gemini and with positive aspects or after a transformation it probably is wonderful for developing skills in education and a variety of potential business ventures. It may be somewhat weakened here though as it would be in Fall if Chiron is elevated in Sagittarius. Also, Chiron in the 3rd has potential to be damaging to people who have a mass or public influence, perhaps due to a misuse of Chironic qualities making them more of a target. Peers, siblings, neighbours and others may be sources of rejection or marginalization which could expand the Gemini Chiron’s tendency to run, hide or harbour thoughts and feeling that further harm their sense of security and trust. This may lead to feelings of persecution or paranoia or a victim mentality causing them to strike out. Having said this, the mutable signs do often tend to attract more victimization than other signs, however, they also are the expert perpetrators of manipulation. It’s likely that an acceptance of their woundedness and an experience of soul transformation could evoke more empathy and compassion for others bringing about their greatest gifts. Otherwise, a vulnerable Chiron in Gemini may attract several losses, increased insecurity and pain, and encourage them to act out in ways that may be harmful to themselves and others. (Prince Harry, Duke of Sussex – Chiron in Gemini in 5th, opposite Mars-Uranus conjunction in 11th, with focal point of T-square to Mercury in Virgo in 8th, trine Venus in Libra in 8th – Created Invictus Games for wounded warriors, has a much criticized marriage and sometimes painful family life, surprised everyone with a tell-all book that spared no one.)

virgo.author: Rob Shaw
virgo.work: Chiron in the Signs and Houses
virgo.principle: Chiron in Virgo may be in its own sign which could give it extra strength in the sign of the Virgin. They would tend to be more sacrificing than many other Chiron sign placements, willing to do work that others would rather avoid. There is a lot of potential positivity with Chiron in Virgo, and better if it is positively aspected. Even then, they may attract deep wounding which they could carry inside them for some time. If they are able to accept, release and transform their pain, they will probably show real maverick and wounded healer qualities. Although they may not work in health, hygiene, or education, they are still probably going to choose another field where they can provide excellent service to others. They may see themselves as weak and inefficient but that is probably insecurity. At worst, they may be self-blaming and if they don’t find happiness, they may feel morose, bitter, complaining and critical. Self-sacrifice may become martyrdom but probably without the emotional blackmail the water signs might succumb to. Their pain may be transformed into artistic abilities, especially music, poetry or as a life or health coach. At best, Chiron in Virgo could direct them to a career assisting others less fortunate, the downtrodden, those needing health care, especially mental health care, or in a field of alternative health. They may be very kind, thoughtful and giving if not struck down by their wounds. Transformation may be delayed or take a lifetime, and they should be encouraged to enjoy gardening, animals, herbalism and horticulture, or any other pastime that has them literally handling the earth. These activities may be grounding for them.

sagittarius.author: Rob Shaw
sagittarius.work: Chiron in the Signs and Houses
sagittarius.principle: It’s possible that Chiron is elevated in Sagittarius, and even if it isn’t this sign should help bring out the very best of Chiron. Sagittarius is a sign not prone to being swayed by the criticism or judgments of others, enjoying their own counsel. Unless the Chiron placement is particularly prone to repeated abuse in childhood, rejection, or they’re overly competitive, then these could become sources of deep pain or wounding. Some Sagittarians may be skittish when threatened and retreat from troubles, demands, or other restrictions in a desire to retain their independence and freedom. But, this Chiron placement may have greater courage and their independent attitude may create a very strong personality and character who loves to be kind, generous and offer help to others. When suffering severe woundedness, Chiron in Sagittarius may be very vulnerable, but their ability to heal and recover over time is augmented. In any mutable sign, Chiron may be victimized by poor health or other people, and sometimes themselves. Unless Chiron is in aspect to harsher planets which may then switch or blend the roles. I.E. the victim later becomes the perpetrator, perhaps in response to deep pain, and they may victimize themselves and others. Negative contacts may also encourage manipulative and narcissistic behaviour, although any Chiron in Sagittarius position may show a great many skills and an ability to endure extreme hardships. (female client – Chiron in Sagittarius in 6th, opposite Mars-Uranus conjunction in late Cancer in 12th but conjunct 1st house Cancer rising, making a T-square with Saturn in Virgo in 3rd, Chiron exact trine to Venus in Leo in 2nd – congenital birth defect with teratological twin attached to hip/thigh leaving inability to walk, half of life spent in wheelchair, over 70 major surgeries. Blessed with a beautiful singing voice, a very kind, generous disposition and loved to perform, a multitude of friends and supporters, and a real source of inspiration to others.)

pisces.author: Rob Shaw
pisces.work: Chiron in the Signs and Houses
pisces.principle:
Although Chiron may be in detriment in Pisces, the sign has much in common with the centaur. Neptune, Pisces’ ruler and his rulership over all liquids including water finds a receptive source in Chiron, the son and husband of two different but powerful sea nymphs. Unfortunately, the rejection and abandonment of Chiron by his mother finds a greater chance of self-harm in the vulnerable sign of Pisces. They are likely more good-natured than other sign placements if not too mopey, but in Pisces they may have to be more wary of those out to take advantage of them. This could have them develop trust issues causing a retreat into a world of their own making, but not necessarily realistic. They may be very reliable as a source of help when really needed, but hopefully not to their own detriment in the sign of self-undoing. Like other softer planets in Pisces, it’s almost heartbreaking to observe the suffering they may endure by others or even their own selves. Chiron in Pisces may be extremely helpful and giving to others, willing to sacrifice and serve to benefit nearly anyone, yet if they don’t take the time to recharge and give to themselves, they will likely manifest ongoing physical or mental health problems. Although Chiron may rule the sign of Virgo, in Pisces he may be even more self-sacrificing and these people often really need the kindness, empathy and compassion of others to keep them strong. If they feel unloved or unappreciated, this can really damage their feelings as a form of perceived rejection creating intense feelings of victimhood that may manifest as a bleeding heart martyr. Some Chiron in Pisces people are prone to emotional blackmail and other forms of manipulation. (female client – Chiron in Pisces in 3rd, conjunct moon in 4th, square Venus & Mars in 6th, sextile Jupiter in 5th – Native given up for adoption, later career as teacher and social worker helping disadvantaged children and adults, divorced an abusive husband, sacrificed very much for her children.)

Chiron in the mutable signs or succedent houses could benefit others greatly but it’s potentially self-damaging. There may be more self-sacrifice and pain in their dealings with others, or they may at first lack inner fortitude and courage to manifest their dreams. Any deep-rooted emotional pain may manifest as physical pain or chronic fatigue, perhaps due to overactivity. They may need to be guarded against the manipulations and repeated wounding by others. More than others, their woundedness may spiritually uplift them by transforming their pain into empathy to educate, heal and inspire others. Surprisingly, afflicted Chiron in these signs and houses may manifest as extreme insecurity and pain, perhaps resulting in cruelty or prejudice towards anyone different, perhaps an ingrained xenophobia. It’s also possible that Chiron is least powerful in the succedent houses, or less seen, or less conscious to the native and others. In other words, they may be society’s unsung heroes and may deserve more support and understanding.

1.author: Rob Shaw
1.work: Chiron in the Signs and Houses
1.principle: They may exhibit extremely good or bad health or character depending on the horoscope. They may enjoy greater self-care, or be terrific in an emergency, or otherwise take the lead in helping others learn or heal. They may have a stronger maverick personality, being really different and not caring one whit about what others may think of them which may have good or bad effects. Chiron positioned here in positive aspect may be very kind, approachable and humble, and is likely to increase an interest in leadership through courageous actions or by being a good example to others. If afflicted in the 1st an increase of self-centeredness could occur, causing them to feel unloved, unseen, and maybe use their pain or insecurity as justification for criticism or attacks on others. Vulnerable narcissism or other mental or physical health issues may manifest, possibly an aggressive personality, or someone caught up in victimhood. (female client – Chiron in Pisces in 1st in T-square to Moon in Gemini in 4th, Chiron opposite Sun, Venus, Uranus, Pluto in Virgo in 7th – suffered, sexual, emotional, physical, mental abuse in childhood, later diagnosed bipolar disorder which has been very limiting, otherwise a very kind, loving person but unable to care for self relying on marital and other family relationships for support rarely feeling fulfilled, strong victim and self-blaming mentality, artistic and creative, successful career working with hands when able to work.)

4.author: Rob Shaw
4.work: Chiron in the Signs and Houses
4.principle: In negative aspect a painful homelife is possible, especially in childhood with abuse by one or both parents, or another family member, or suffering may be endured if the parents divorced. This could lead to future cohabitations with the wrong person, or the home or family continues to be a source of wounding. Feelings of abandonment or rejection by family members, whether real or perceived may be common and lead to them being a tyrant at home. They may afflict pain on others with Chiron here justifying this as “my house rules or get out”. Marriage and partnerships may be a source of abuse if contacting the 7th house. After transformation, or with greater positive aspects, Chiron in the 4th may indicate that the home is where they can relax, be creative, be more active at home or involved with ongoing home décor or renovation when contacting appropriate planets and houses. They may greatly enjoy retreating to their safe home environment, and it is more important to these people to have a safe home space, a “man-cave” or “she-shed” for retreat. Working at home is very possible, as is home-related skills and abilities. They may care for younger or older relatives, treat everyone kindly as family, and be the people that family and friends can really rely upon. They may enjoy hosting family and friends at home, perhaps providing a warm respite for other people.

7.author: Rob Shaw
7.work: Chiron in the Signs and Houses
7.principle: Their marriage, partnerships, and other relationships may be a source of pain, possibly due to fears of being alone. They may seek comfort or healing through partnerships, seeing their refuge in having a partner. If Chiron is afflicted here, their overcompensation for a fear of loneliness can be exactly what brings on more rejection or abandonment. They may give too much to others, perhaps believing this is how to get love back, or they find things are unfair but they may remain in a painful, unfulfilling marriage or relationship longer than they should. They will work hard to achieve balance in partnerships but Chiron here may indicate greater self-sacrifice to “keep the peace” in an attempt to ward off eventual abandonment or rejection. Due to their lack of success in finding a balanced relationship, they may become reclusive, abusive, or prone to depression and loneliness. In positive aspects, this could be someone who can bring security and safety to their relationships, and be wonderful at working as a team. In any case, relationships are usually better if natal aspects to Chiron here are mostly positive, or after their acceptance of, or transmutation of their pain. They may have increased understanding for right vs. wrong and be highly idealistic if not focused too much on painful injustices that chip away at their self-esteem. If their woundedness is not accepted or resolved they may become judgmental or envious of others, needing to learn that we all have pain whether obvious or hidden. After transformation they may show tremendous leadership and team-building skills, due to their empathy and understanding of humanity. (female client – Chiron in Pisces in 7th, conjunct Mercury in Pisces, trine Mars in Cancer in 11th, opposite Pluto in Virgo in 1st – scammed for money and other support by “fiancé”, an energy vampire who said he was childless and single, but she later found he was married with children. However, she has genius intellect and is a wonderful academic, writer, coach and teacher.)

10.author: Rob Shaw
10.work: Chiron in the Signs and Houses
10.principle: Chiron here may indicate their work, career, or public image could be outstandingly positive, or a part of their suffering if afflicted by planets in the other angular houses. This could bring them a painful notoriety at some time, but indicate a potential for both positive and negative outcomes. E.g. If the home life or marriage brings them pain they may spend more time at their career leading to business success. They may be involved in a positive or negative transformation of a business. However aspected, Chiron here may be too focused on their work and career, possibly to the detriment of family happiness. With more positive aspects to a 10th house Chiron to other earth or water signs, or after a painful transformation, they may be able to access immense talents for healing, guiding or education of others, and great success at work. Their abilities in business may lead them to a leadership role in the public eye, potentially bringing wealth to themselves and others. May be a very public rise and/or fall due to their work.

2.author: Rob Shaw
2.work: Chiron in the Signs and Houses
2.principle: The native may have had a very rough childhood with a 2nd house Chiron. They may have experienced abandonment, rejection, abuse (including sexual), neglect, poverty, or other soul-destroying ills. If only positively aspected the reverse may be true, attracting wonderful blessings, much like when Saturn is well-posited here. Their pain may drive them to great financial or work success, but hopefully not at the cost of their health or social relationships. There would probably be a greater interest in a Chiron related field of work such as health care, education, police/military, or the arts. As this is a house of finance and career they may do very well in any business handling money, food, material goods, or anything that sustains and nurtures. Neglect or abuse in any love or friendly relationship may cause them to suffer and contribute to trust issues. Insecurity may be rooted in a personal wounding, especially if taken advantage of in love or money. They may work hard to be prosperous, and after a transformation or with positive planetary aspects become very successful, perhaps through opportunity and helpful friendships.

5.author: Rob Shaw
5.work: Chiron in the Signs and Houses
5.principle: Chiron appears to flourish here in the house of creativity, hobbies and avocations as he can manifest natural multi-talented abilities and truly shine. This can bring better emotional, personal, avocational and career success through their relationships, especially involving the arts, education and apprenticeship, or social causes and connections. Their children or friends may be people they frequently make sacrifices for, and they may have high expectations for their children to succeed. With natal positive aspects or after transformation, Chiron can find an excellent outlet in the 5th house to manifest its best qualities. If negatively aspected, or if the native carries their woundedness for too long resisting transformation, they may not be a very good friend to others, becoming critical, jealous or avoidant. They may also attract abuse, neglect or wounding by friends, lovers or children. Sometimes they may hang out with the wrong kind of friends that bring them shame and unhappiness. They may avoid intimacy due to previous hurtful relationships, and if an 8th house affliction is involved, carry secrets of abuse or extramarital affairs, their own or others.

8.author: Rob Shaw
8.work: Chiron in the Signs and Houses
8.principle: Chiron may be surprisingly more in his element hidden from view in the 8th house, however not without some potentially deep-seated wounds or several dead-end projects. Sexual or financial problems which may be hidden may contribute to feelings of insecurity and increase controlling behaviour. When afflicted, Chiron here may be harsh and vindictive if their progress or goals are thwarted, causing more pain to others and thereby themselves over time. Like when Chiron is in the 2nd house, financial losses are possible, and not only through investments and joint partnerships. Painful divorces with money or custody battles are possible. In positive aspect the native could benefit from their own or others’ wealth or financial wisdom, or especially after a painful transformation. Sexual abuse issues or related problems may be indicated here, or control or dominance activities may arise. Like the other spiritual signs and houses, Chiron here can lead to greater awareness of spiritual, religious or mystical beliefs and practices which can help them transcend the more painful qualities associated with this sign and house. There may be an increased desire to work in health care or social services, giving an added chance for the person to be noble and accomplished. Transformation is part of the 8th house energy so it is likely that most Chiron placements here could lead to increased effort and greater wisdom until they succeed. If no outlets are provided to Chiron here or elsewhere in the chart, then Chiron may contribute a lot of woundedness to others. (female client – Chiron in Aquarius conjunct Venus in 8th, opposing Uranus in Leo in 1st with focal point of T-square being Jupiter-Neptune conjunction in Scorpio in 5th – serious accident in childhood requiring long convalescence and therapy, sexual abuse in childhood, abandoned by parents, later difficulty with intimacy and friendships, but successful career in social services and creatively gifted in nearly all art forms, her art not only therapeutically healing for herself, but also evokes powerful connection and healing in others.)

11.author: Rob Shaw
11.work: Chiron in the Signs and Houses
11.principle: There is likely to be a greater awareness of and desire to work for social causes or as an agent or advocate for a group concern. When positively aspected, or after transformation, the Chiron individual can bring together friends, teams or groups of people that share their interests and effect some real humanitarian changes. It appears the Aquarian ideals can manifest well with Chiron here. As with other 11th house planets, social climbing may be a part of the agenda and this may be good, bad or neutral depending on the horoscope. The native may have many hopes and dreams but without solid connections to other planets and houses they may just remain a scattering of unfulfilled dreams, potentially a source of disillusionment and pain. They may appear to be a little “other-worldly” or unfathomable to others as their multitude of interests and “causes” may be even contradictory or somewhat bizarre. Still, they may be enigmatic and difficult to pin down or understand, perhaps adding to their sense of being alone and misunderstood. The depth of woundedness around these issues may greatly depend on the rest of the horoscope and aspects to Chiron in the 11th. (Meghan Markle, Duchess of Sussex – Chiron in Taurus in the 11th trine Venus in Virgo in the 2nd, Chiron quincunx Pluto in Libra in the 4th, and Neptune in Sagittarius in the 5th forming a Yod. Known for her activities in acting, writing and humanitarian causes, as well as her marriage to Prince Harry and stormy relationships with her family and in-laws.)

3.author: Rob Shaw
3.work: Chiron in the Signs and Houses
3.principle: There may be a myriad of possibilities here but with a need to focus for best success. Chiron may help them do just that while also giving them multiple skills. Likely, a balance of positive and negative aspects would be the best recipe for success. If too positive there may be too many things going on, and although multi-talented the usual jack-of-all-trades Mercurial qualities may occur leading to a negative impact, and not just dishonesty, dissipation, or confusion when not properly applied. If too negative, there may be a surprising tendency to egotism, perhaps in reaction to deep insecurity. They may be subject to the manipulations of others, or they may become expert manipulators, “manipulating the message” for their own gain. At worst, they can be purveyors of victim-perpetrator games, or increased fickleness that leaves them disillusioned. Difficulties in communication will be their likely source of trouble potentially preventing healing and recovery until they accept their participation in the process. Working with their ideas or hands could be their best outlet to counter deep emotional pain and perhaps lead to greater self-acceptance of their pain and their tremendous abilities. Once they transform their woundedness, their maverick tendencies could bring them great success with one or more of their many talents. (Vladimir Putin – Chiron in Capricorn in 3rd, square Sun in Libra in 11th which conjuncts Saturn in Libra in 12th, Chiron sextile Venus in Scorpio in 1st – Russian dictator and mass murderer, dishonest manipulator, narcissist and egomaniac, former KGB, hides behind what he thinks is a charming facade.)

6.author: Rob Shaw
6.work: Chiron in the Signs and Houses
6.principle: We have Chiron in its own house that it may rule, and certainly Chiron here would probably best use his skills and abilities resulting in outstanding manifestations. The centaur of service and sacrifice in the 6th is likely to be very hardworking. If not working in a field of health, healing or education, they may excel at administrative and management positions due to their great organizational abilities. They may be too organized and adherent to their own processes, or possibly be reluctant to change. If insecure or mistrusting, they may be too changeable in fear of making mistakes if it is afflicted. They may attract painful work or health situations requiring great fortitude to endure. Their pain is more likely to be internalized and they may sacrifice their happiness for a host of reasons, not just attention to duty. They could get caught up in victim-perpetrator games, or they may be a very different personality in the workplace than at home. If Chiron has only positive aspects, or they’re able to be transformed, they may have a decisively good effect on others, helping them to grow in their career, or grow beyond personal pain just as they did. They could be a natural health care worker, whether doctor, nurse, or a first responder. Chiron in the 6th house is may be a person that a lot of people rely upon, and who often delivers their best, even if suffering in silence, or constantly complaining. (male client – Chiron in Sagittarius in 6th, square Saturn in Virgo in 4th, sextile Venus in Aquarius in 7th, and sextile Neptune in Libra in 4th, highly regarded at work and led many work teams to success in automotive plastics industry, but suffered childhood abuse and in turn was abusive to family at home, internalized pain, never receiving therapy or acknowledging wounds, later died quickly due to several life threatening diseases manifesting at once.)

9.author: Rob Shaw
9.work: Chiron in the Signs and Houses
9.principle: We can imagine Chiron doing very well in the house of higher education and life’s philosophies. Its fellow centaur’s house may allow great cooperation between the two and open all its doors in this house. There may be a greater need for freedom leading them to enjoy travel and encourage their imagination. Woundedness could come from accidents in travel, displacement, immigration or interactions with a foreign power, or possibly a desire for but lack of a better education or opportunities. If their blockages or deterrents are relieved over time, they may acquire great knowledge and wisdom and be able to give that back as a teacher or professor of a specialized topic. They may be keepers of the law working in a branch of the military, or break the law if afflicted by harsher planets. Some conflicting planetary aspects may encourage the more negative and regressive “centaur” traits, such as dissipation, addiction, or rowdy, aggressive behaviour especially if opportunities for growth are blocked With positive planetary contacts and signs, or after an enlightened transformation, the potential benefits could embrace truly magnificent outcomes in a house that is Jupiter ruled.

12.author: Rob Shaw
12.work: Chiron in the Signs and Houses
12.principle: It would be expected to see a greater interest in health, healing, humanitarian causes, and more with Chiron here. The dissolving influence of the 12th house could be helpful or maybe not, depending on the horoscope and planets involved. With softer contacts, they may be extremely caring towards others and self-sacrificing. The native should be encouraged to seek education and work in health or another form of humanitarian care or government. This placement could bring about their own health problems related to an inability to properly process emotions and trauma, which would be difficult to find an outlet in the 12th house. If they can convert painful energies in a selfless way without causing harm to themselves or others, the positive manifestations could be wondrous. In general, Chiron in the house of self-undoing may contribute to just that; a great potential for deep woundedness of self or others, self-destruction, or perhaps needless pain unless they integrate their sense of giving, sacrifice and humility without self-victimization and martyrdom. As the axial house to the 6th house, some Chiron placements here may contribute to a greater good. If too negatively aspected to harsher planets, they may suffer greatly, or cause the suffering of others.
